defs.def: a level of quality, especially one that people think is acceptable （品质的）标准，水平，规格，规范

ex.s: What does the author think of victors' standards for joining the genius club?
ex.t: 作者认为胜利者加入天才俱乐部的标准如何?.

ex.s: But can uniforms help improve school standards?
ex.t: 但校服能帮助提高学校标准吗?

ex.s: Second, if other factors such as technology remain constant, economic growth and material expectations will fall well below recent standards and this could invite trouble.
ex.t: 第二,如果技术等其他因素保持不变,经济增长和物质期望将远远低于最近的标准,这可能会引起麻烦。

ex.s: The standard method of conducting hypnosis.
ex.t: 进行催眠的标准方法.

ex.s: It's said that history is written by the victors, and those victors set the standards for admission to the genius club.
ex.t: 据说历史是由胜利者写成的,那些胜利者制定了进入天才俱乐部的标准.

ex.s: decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes.
ex.t: 五年前决定为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独的标准,这些标准低于大型飞机的飞行员。

ex.s: We are therefore not talking about adapting to a new standard, but to a constantly shifting set of conditions.
ex.t: 因此,我们不是要适应新的标准,而是要适应不断变化的一系列条件。

ex.s: This medicine, which was called artemisinin, soon became a standard treatment for malaria.
ex.t: 这种药被称作青蒿素,很快成为治疗疟疾的标准药.

ex.s: Li Dan is a woman who has discovered that returning home to work in the field of agriculture could offer her both a meaningful challenge and a good standard of living.
ex.t: 李丹是一位妇女,她发现回国务农既能给她带来有意义的挑战,又能提供良好的生活水平.

ex.s: He invited me to play a game, which was very simple by today’s standards, but we loved it!
ex.t: 他邀请我玩一个游戏,

ex.s: You have quite a lot of friends, but You have high standards.Your most of them sayyouwere reallyquiet friends think you are a person with and serious when they first met you.

defs.def: a level of quality that is normal or acceptable for a particular person or in a particular situation 正常的水平；应达到的标准

ex.s: High-end products around the world are made to a higher standard now because of advanced technology which was first created to meet the requirements for space exploration.
ex.t: 世界各地的高端产品现在都达到了更高的标准,因为先进技术最初是为满足空间探索的要求而创造的。

defs.def: a level of behaviour that sb considers to be morally acceptable 行为标准；道德水准
a unit of measurement that is officially used; an official rule used when producing sth 法定度量衡标准；法定含量；技术规范；产品规格

ex.s: BMF’s technical standards.
ex.t: 生物放大系数的技术标准。

defs.def: a flag that is used during official ceremonies, especially one connected with a particular military group 仪式上使用的旗帜；（尤指）军旗
a song that has been recorded by many different singers （很多歌手录制过的）歌曲
average or normal rather than having special or unusual features 普通的；正常的；通常的；标准的

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近,我构思了一个与地球环境相关的新计时方法, 条件可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一个钟表, 反映几条阿拉斯加主要河流的总流量, 这些河流对当地和全球环境变化很敏感。我们已经计划它与原子钟相匹配, 如果水道以目前的速度继续流动。 如果河流在未来平均运行得更快, 时钟会比标准时间提前。如果它们运行得慢, 你会看到相反的效果。

ex.s: Mann said Terrafugia was helped by the Federal Aviation  Administration’s decision five years ago to create a separate set of standards for light sport aircraft, which are lower than those pilots of larger planes Terrafugia says an owner would need to pass a test and complete 20 hours of flying time to be able to fly the Transition, a requirement pilots would find relatively easy to meet.
ex.t: Mann说,Terrafugia在5年前联邦航空管理局决定为轻型运动飞机制定一套单独的标准的帮助下得到了帮助,该标准低于大型飞机的飞行员Terrafugia说,机主需要通过测试并完成20个小时的飞行时间才能驾驶过渡飞机,要求的飞行员会发现相对容易满足。

defs.def: following a particular standard set, for example, by an industry （符合）标准的；按一定规格制作的

ex.s: The Transition is now going through crash tests to make sure it meets federal safety standards.
ex.t: 过渡队目前正在进行坠机测试,以确保其符合联邦安全标准。

ex.s: This variety, coupled with the fact that tiny forests grow up to ten times faster than standard forests, means they attract a rich abundance of wildlife.
